Version: 9.0.0.cl or later Creates a tag object. Tags are labels that identify a metadata object. For example, you can create a tag to designate subject areas, such as sales, HR, marketing, and finance. Requires `ADMINISTRATION` (**Can administer ThoughtSpot**) privilege. If [Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)](https://developers.thoughtspot.com/docs/rbac) is enabled on your instance, the `TAGMANAGEMENT` (**Can manage tags**) privilege is required to create, edit, and delete tags. #### Endpoint URL
